metadata.description: Canvas LMS course-building tools for instructors (Claude Code plugins).

plugins.name: courseforge
plugins.description: CourseForge: build, place, and schedule whole Canvas courses (migrate from Notion or generate pages/syllabi/assignments/quizzes/exams, weekly modules, weighted grading, nav trim, auto due dates). Content-first; includes one opt-in best-effort blind-grading flow that keeps identities local.

plugins.name: canvas-pii-guard
plugins.description: Local PII-prevention hooks: blocks Canvas student-data API calls and local-cache reads before they run, so student data is never fetched or transmitted. Install on instructor machines alongside courseforge.
